notes: Core architecture is GO and the product is a Windows release candidate. A real Windows VS Code Claude Code 2.1.243 session received a PackRat-owned queued request through the documented Stop-hook continuation path and continued in the same conversation. Normal session UI uses a short preview of the latest real user prompt and keeps exact session identifiers in advanced diagnostics only. The installer bundles ready-made profiles for five Stream Deck families. PackRat stores queued prompts locally, preserves existing Claude settings and third-party hooks, never reads Claude credentials, and does not claim external control of Claude Code's private native queued-message UI. Hook integration uses a per-install authenticated localhost endpoint, fail-safe session targeting, a six-continuation safety cap, a 9,000-character queue prompt ceiling, locked dependencies, and direct discovery of native Windows Claude Code plus the CLI bundled with VS Code and common VS Code forks.
